rules.name: combined-var-slow-03-snapshot-stats
rules.sql: SELECT relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, n_mod_since_analyze, last_analyze, last_autoanalyze, last_autovacuum FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot', 'recon_snapshot_pointer', 'cloned_security_info_table') ORDER BY relname

SELECT s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, count(DISTINCT s.run_id) AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.builder_version IS NULL) AS no_builder FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s JOIN opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p ON p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = s.business_unit AND p.settlement_date = s.settlement_date AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.published_run_id = s.run_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date ORDER BY s.settlement_date DESC, s.business_unit LIMIT 20
rules.explain: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s JOIN opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p ON p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = s.business_unit AND p.settlement_date = s.settlement_date AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.published_run_id = s.run_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(s.business_unit) = 'RMC'
